spec: Fix one time of day, one light direction, one colour bias across every subject, so warm-cool spread stays under 10 even if brightness swings. Crop to two ratios at most. Lift blacks 7-9%, hold highlights under 96%, saturation about 70%. Dusk amber for drama, matte daylight for calm.

Shoot on the page palette: ground, wardrobe and props drawn from its neutrals and accent. Grade seamless backgrounds to within 2-4% of the page colour so edges melt. One image per viewport or one-row colour story, flat frontal framing, no text on images, no borders.

One object on one coloured seamless, single soft key from one side, long soft shadow, shallow focus. Object fills about 50% of tile width, same scale across all tiles. Every tile shares one tone range. Ground colour carries the identity; no props unless they repeat.

Transparent cut-out on the exact tile colour, no floor line. Overlap colourways so the group fills about 90% of tile width, one soft contact shadow. Knolled parts in a loose grid on flat colour also work. Packs may rotate -12 to +15 degrees. Clean mask or do not use it.

Crop tighter than feels safe: object cut by the frame on two sides, texture left unretouched. Natural side light, square corners or one 12-20px radius across the set. Alternate macro with one frontal or wide frame for scale. No overlay, no caption inside the image.

Real moments, not staged: hands, gesture, equipment in use, wide places with small figures. One tile recipe across all frames: radius 8-24px, 16:10 or 4:5, caption below at 12-14px. Vary shot distance tile to tile. No grade toward brand colour if honesty is the point.

One camera position repeated exactly: overhead, same pale ground, soft window light, subject filling about 85% of a square or 4:5 tile. Radius 12-16px or square with 8px gaps. Captions under the frame at 12-14px. A single different angle breaks the set.

Plan images in pairs: neighbours contrast in tone or scale, never subject. Black-and-white grain beside saturated studio colour, macro beside wide, dark tile diagonal to light tile. Butt frames with 0-2px gaps. Photography supplies all page colour. No scrims, no filters.

Edge-to-edge or 20-32px radius panel. Subject composed to one side, copy on the open dark area at the page gutter, no scrim. Zone luminance spread under 0.04; white contrast at least 7 for body, 3.5 for 30px-plus display. If the zone fails, change the frame.

Native ratio, no radius, shadow, tint or inner caption. Fix one dimension: height up to 720px for a sequence, or a 330-420px column with unequal heights for an index. Interface stays neutral so all colour comes from the work. Caption below, 13px, centred or left.

Subject shot on true black, masked to a 570×760 vertical ellipse in a 720px panel, 2-3px bevel so the edge reads as cut paper. Mirror two per row. Or encode meaning: equal-height ellipses of varied width forming a waveform. Hard-edged subject only, never a feathered photo.

Candid prints tilted 1-2 degrees, up to 8 for scrapbook, overlapping each other and the headline base by 10-20px. Two sizes such as 450×300 and 258×335. One physical cue: clear tape, slide mount or 3px white border, soft 2-6px shadow. Keep one element perfectly straight.

One construction repeated: hard rectangles butted and overlapped with no radius or shadow, one colour story; or a context plate with a smaller flat artefact on top; or torn-paper collage thumbnails at radius 4px or less. Interface stays neutral around it.

Inside a radius 16 tile, overlay product output on a real photo: 9px outline triangles and a few 28px radius 7 squares, 1-1.5px white, placed on detected corners, never at random. Or one drawn 5px route ending in a dot. Choose frames with structure across the image.

Apply one screen to every photo: a 3px checker of two tints of the local colour, ±5-15% amplitude, slight hue split, at display resolution. Or 20px mosaic tiles, 2px gap in a darker copy of each tile, outline stepped in 3-5 tile blocks. No untreated photos beside it.

Greyscale first, then map shadow, mid and light to three palette stops so any photo lands in the same inks. Keep stops at least 60 L* apart so faces read. Pair with flat shapes in the same colours. One map per page. Plain black and white is the quiet form.

30-degree isometric plates, cubes and fins, 1px strokes at 13-34% ink, fills equal to page colour for occlusion, hidden edges dashed 2-3 at 10%. One element may have mass or colour. About 280px wide in a three-column row, small mono figure label above.

Plan-view line glyphs in one 96px box, one 1px stroke at about 34% ink, square terminals. 6px filled squares mark live nodes, dashed lines optional parts, fainter strokes secondary ones. Ten per grid, one cell lit to 78% with accent corner ticks. Accent only on what is live.

Flat accent fills, 1.5px ink outlines, white shapes, small second-colour dots, open-chevron connectors, on 20px grid paper at 6% ink in 300×190 cells. Objects overlap, connect, and one crops at the cell edge. One recurring motif marks the key node. No gradients.

1px grey wireframe at about 330px with centre lines, arrowed extension lines and rotated 12px mono dimensions, then cross-fade to the real object at identical position and scale. Or a large axonometric with neighbours pale and only the project tinted. Real dimensions only.

Draw at one-third size, ordered-dither along one colour ramp per material, one-pixel silhouette in an accent, display at exactly 3x with pixelated rendering, transparent on page. Or a dot globe: 4px dots, density shows land, about 800px wide, cut flat at the base.

A template, not fifty images, generated from data. Deep two-stop gradient, logo top-left, 118px gradient numeral, 19px caption, radius 8. Or grey collage: parts cropped off the frame, three scales, one dither band, one flat hue per cover, tiny corner marks, covers 3px apart.

Flat tinted panel, five to seven wandering lines one step lighter, 4-6px wide, running off every edge, never crossing, no closed loops. Isolines of warped noise plus a directional ramp. One field per tile. Keep type off it, or on a solid chip.

Strict structure, slight tremor: 1.25-2px near-black line, 60-100px, pale filled nodes or patches as the only tone, at most one flat colour. Let the drawing encode meaning, such as branches multiplying per tier. Keep to margins, tiles and emblems, never behind text.

One constant 1-1.5px line, no fills, running down the page and knotting into spot drawings at key sections, crossing section joins, flipping colour on dark bands. Or one 1280px pen drawing carrying small white callout tiles. Type indents to clear it.

One or two inks. Stippled plates about 600px with edges dissolving by grain into the ground, unframed, one per product; or 100px ink heads, colour kept in nearby labels. Same grain and palette across the series. Reuse as crest, avatar or watermark. Use real or public-domain sources.

Hold one medium: grainy ink with saturated flats, or gouache figures without outlines, or watercolour bleeding into white. Frames about 416×256, spots about 150×100. Fills sit slightly out of register. Figures overlap layout edges. Real art or tightly style-controlled generation only.

Plan three scales from the start: logo, spot, closing scene. One simple construction, thick 3px outline or no outline, flat fill in the brand accent. New pose per section, always overlapping a panel edge, never centred in a slot. Spots 230-300px, inline 44-80px.

Flat shapes, no outlines or gradients, about six hues, same objects recurring from hero to footer. Shapes merge into section colours, so the page ends as a scene. Pastel panels at radius 16, or full-bleed colour. Grain or a second flat shade adds depth.

Flat vector objects with an even 5-8px keyline around the whole silhouette, no shadow, slightly rotated, tucked at section edges and clipped by the next section. Optional halftone burst inside. Bold-colour and expressive pages only.

Cut-paper scenes photographed or rendered with soft drop shadows on a flat saturated field. One subject per screen, centred, about 50% of height, one light direction across the series, slightly imperfect paper edges.

One library or one hand. 16px icon, 10px gap, 14px label, 32px row pitch, 1.5px stroke, round caps and joins, currentColor. A different glyph per row, never repeated ticks. Stroke halves in viewBox units at 32px so it stays 1.5 on screen.

Yes: 14px solid ink disc with a white tick. No: 11px thin cross in the third ink, so absences recede. Info: 14px pale dot. Dark form: 16px white circle tick, muted plus-circle for inherited rows. Rows 32-48px tall with 1px rules.

Replace bullets with 14px source marks, plain tick for generic rows. Payment marks 24×16, radius 2, 8px gaps, full colour in a neutral row. Or 16px outlined product glyphs, one hue each, as an index key at 29px pitch.

40px solid marks from two or three overlapping tones of one colour ramp, no strokes, no tile. Overlap draws the form. Sit on the column left edge, 12px above a 14px bold title. Ramp matches the hero. Never under 24px.

One solid container, one rule: 56px near-black hexagon with white geometric glyphs knocked out, no line icons. Or 80px squircle, radius 20, 1px light 10% border, glyph centred, 16px label below. Shape must echo the logo.

Turn a real product component into the icon container. Event chip form: 90×80, radius 6, pale tint, 10px saturated left bar, 1.5px line icon in that hue with about 47px of ink, six colours. Scattered in margins at staggered heights, never over text.

Redraw a dull mark set in the page's own device: bold silhouettes as 1px horizontal scanlines on a 3px pitch, about 35% white, 72px, in a four-cell hairline row with 14px grey labels. Echo the hero pattern exactly.

Draw on 16×16 and show at exactly 3×, 48px, crispEdges. Dark one-pixel outline, two or three flat fills, stepped edges, no anti-aliasing. The only illustrative colour on an otherwise neutral documentation page.

Objects rendered with one setup: soft clay or gloss, top-left key, one contact shadow, same camera. About 48px, baked at 2×. Replaces flat glyphs in consumer navigation. Same family returns larger in modals and empty states.
44px pale embossed icons with white 14px labels and dark text shadow, 84px pitch down both screen edges over a wallpaper. Break the set once on purpose. Only inside a site built as a desktop.

State the mark in numbers: 3×3 solid squares at 13px, gap 3px, corner 2px, 44px total, with a pixel-fitted 16px master. Or an 80×88 outlined box, 2px stroke, one sheared corner, three rows of tracked capitals. Scales unchanged, inverts cleanly.

Name in the dealt type at -.025em, plus one device with a reason: a .42em dot that repeats large on product, .075em bars on chosen letters, or a 13px version number in a 1px chip. Must survive at nav size and pay off large in the footer.

Letters from square modules on a 5-high grid, no curves or anti-aliasing, crispEdges. Width always a whole number of modules. Nav about 154×26, large as art, one letter in a 64px radius-12 tile for product icons. Panels and notches share the same grid.

One clean cut through heavy letters: a hairline horizontal slice at about 34% of cap height, stencil gaps in bowls, or a diagonal slash taller than the letters splitting two colours. Cut is at least 1px at the smallest size, and only where strokes are wide.

One 1-1.5px stroke, oval 65×85 fixed bottom-left or 105×135 in the footer. Tracked caps on a path round the ring, two display letters at the centre. Below 40px, drop to the ring and one letter. The page's one decorative object.

Solid rectangle pinned to a page corner: 80×50 with a two-line 14px bold wordmark at a 6px inset, square corners; or a fixed 150×225 tab flush top-left that overlaps every section. Supplies the page's one strong colour.

Redraw the mark per scale, never just resize it: 58px seal in nav, 40px footer, 560px flat mid-grey version with heavier strokes as a whole band. Reuse as divider, placeholder, overlay and closing wordmark, and put it on the product itself.

A custom pictogram per item inside one fixed container: 38px black square, white glyph drawn from the object itself, right-aligned above the title beside the image. Same weight and square throughout. Or larger square tiles as map pins. Needs at least six items.
One state change only: hero wordmark hands off to a 20px bar version past the hero; or a 50×36 mark of three bars shears through states with scroll; or logo and menu icon share one box and weight.

Squircle 100-255px, radius 17-24% of the side, one glyph or gem render, 1-2px lighter inner rim, light from one direction. Hero signature instead of an eyebrow, or a closing object straddling a band. Below 24px, use the glyph alone.

Reserved for one large moment: about 200px soft-bevelled mark rotating on scroll, a 176px twisted-ribbon letter above a reveal line, or a hard 6px extrusion on a heavy wordmark. Flat version everywhere else.
A hand-signed tag about 145px wide in one flat colour, repeated on loader, footer and product. Or die-cut wordmark stickers with a 16px outline, rotated up to 10 degrees, dropped in margins.

Isometric cubes, three flat tones, no gradient or texture. One lattice face per block, 5×5 thin bars in the block's tone, mostly mid-grey panes, a few dark; the other face solid, carrying small lettering. Lead block in the accent, its panes white, some recessed. Floor two pale tints.

CSS 3D at rotateX 55, rotateZ -40. Near-opaque top plate with real text, tinted base plate with code, two translucent side walls, dashed verticals, blurred accent glow beneath. About 640px scene. Or one 220px glass cube among 40 grey tiles to mark one item.

145px tile, radius 36, dark gradient, 1px inner light. One glossy object at 65% of the tile, lit by a coloured strip in the environment, thin glow along the base, one hue per section. Centred 30px above headings. Or a 763×400 cover with one chrome-black object at right.

Pure black ground, no floor, no glow. Thin grazing strip lights plus dim soft boxes, satin metal at roughness about .38, knurling, bevels and micro-lettering. Long lens, 22-degree field. One object or a tight rhythm about 800px wide. One hue on one element only.

One matte tone over everything, soft even light, visible ambient occlusion, no texture. About 650px object on a bare same-tone ground, rotating with scroll, or a full clay scene with faint labels. Small coloured mono labels are the only colour.
A 3D part rotates, then flips to line art at exactly the same position, scale and angle as the section ground changes. One moment per page. Use an edge pass or two registered images.

Parts separated along one axis with equal gaps, lit from above, one soft shadow under the last part. Small numbered black dots on near-white, with the numbered specification in small caps below. Or silver plates with one accent plate, about 280px, reused as one object family.

Object about 1000px wide cropped by its tile, no device frame, tilted about 20 degrees, lit from upper left so every small form casts a shadow. Micro-grain, legible lettering. Copy-free chapter, or sits straight on a grain-filled tile.

One material truth, lit for it: ribbed knit under soft even light with no cast shadow, base fading into the page; or matte black hardware where labels supply all colour, tumbling 30-40 degrees; or a glossy floor with a long reflection. UI may sit on the reflection.

Form with structure and grain: 150-400px spheres with hard colour facets, heavy film grain, dark terminator, soft contact shadow, no two alike, crossing section edges. Or one 1340px ribbon of 1-2px streak lines with an edge dissolving away. Not a soft glow.

Object rotated 15-20 degrees with one soft shadow, centred on flat colour. Fan cards at about 15 degrees on black, or etch thin brand lines into a white slab. Extreme crops on soft grey lift it. Prefer a real cut-out photograph when available.

Small soft 3D characters about 70px, two-mark faces, one shared light and shadow, reused inside labels and diagrams so they read as recurring agents. Vinyl gloss at 130-190px on dark for agencies. Never hero-size without real character work.

Make footage nearly abstract: heavy horizontal motion blur, faces never sharp, or slow macro in near black with one edge light. One saturated note at most. Radius 16 in a panel or full 100vh. Type or a translucent UI card sits directly on it, no scrim.

100vw, about 830px tall or 100vh, hard crop top and bottom, autoplay muted loop. One 36px ring pause control top right, 20px inset. No captions, or white type straight on a set whose palette guarantees contrast. Poster set, reduced motion shows it.

Small muted 16:9 loops of 2-6 seconds replacing stills, one frame recipe, no player chrome, caption beneath at 12-14px. Palettes differ tile to tile, which makes the rhythm. Play only tiles in view, poster otherwise.

Lifestyle footage in a radius 42 frame. Two-line 24px white caption with a 28px app-icon chip placed in a calm part of the scene, as if the product spoke. 32px round controls bottom right. One line per shot.

Strong still, no scrim, one frame radius. Play drawn from your system: 84px square, radius 12, page-surface fill, thin outline triangle; or 90px solid accent circle with white triangle; or 72px frosted orb. Centred. Load the player only on click.

Column-width clip about 624px, radius 8, 1px border at 6%. Controls inside the frame: play, volume, 13px tabular time, 3px scrubber, remaining time, fullscreen, white with no panel. On bright footage add a 64px local gradient under the strip only.

Four tiles 288×440-480, radius 12, same framing. 80px translucent grey play disc at 36% height, blurred backdrop. Bottom scrim with 16px semibold name and one-line outcome in white. Or 322×570, 64px black circle, caption and shop link below.

Dark translucent card 202×240, radius 20, 32px inset at hero bottom right. Thumbnail 186×124, radius 12, 24px outlined play circle, 16px tight caption, 10px mono duration. A second story without a second button.

Real footage dimmed to about 55%, then real product output on top: one filled box on the lead object, 1px outlines on the rest, 10px labels on 15px tabs. Or black-and-white footage with chromatic fringing and word-by-word captions at centre.
